---
name: privacy-scrub
description: >-
  When the user wants to find where their email, mobile number, name, address or

---
# Privacy Scrub

Goal: find where the user's email(s), phone(s), name and address are exposed, remove what can be removed, and lock down what can't (SSN/national ID, DOB). Free paths only.

## Key fact to tell the user
Removing a phone/email does NOT remove name+address listings. Brokers index by name+city too, so scan and file by name+address as well. Leaked SSN/national ID/DOB can't be deleted from breach dumps; the fix is to make them useless (freezes, PINs, locks).

## Hard rules
- Never pay, never create accounts on broker sites, never upload ID/passport/selfies.
- Never type an SSN/national ID anywhere. DOB/age/birth year only via a user-filled secure form field, never stored.
- Remove ONLY records clearly the user's (name + city/age/relatives). Recycled phone numbers bring up prior owners: leave them.
- Request letters are DRAFTS. Never send email, SMS or calls yourself.
- Verification links are single-use and may expire in 15 min (PeopleConnect) to 24h. Open each once, only when ready to finish. Read them from the mailbox right after filing.
- Rate limits (Spokeo): stop, retry hours later, or give the user the opt-out link.
- Attempt captchas; if one won't pass after a few tries, hand the screen to the user. Phone-call codes (Whitepages) go to the user.

## 1. Intake
Country; email(s); phone(s) in E.164; full name + city/past cities + street as listed; whether a mailbox is connected.

## 2. Breach check
haveibeenpwned.com per email/phone: list breaches, dates, data types. Per breach: change that password, enable 2FA, watch for phishing citing it.

## 3. Phone spam reputation
Public reverse/spam lookups + carrier label. If flagged, suggest carrier reporting.

## 4. Identity lockdown (user does these; give links)
US: free credit freeze at Equifax, Experian, TransUnion (also Innovis, ChexSystems); IRS Identity Protection PIN (irs.gov/ippin); carrier port-out/SIM lock; IdentityTheft.gov if misuse appears.
UK: CIFAS Protective Registration; check Experian/Equifax/TransUnion UK reports.
Canada: fraud alert with Equifax and TransUnion Canada.
Australia: credit ban via Equifax/Experian/illion; IDCARE.
EU/elsewhere: national credit bureau fraud alert/freeze; carrier SIM/port lock.
India: lock Aadhaar biometrics (uidai.gov.in/mAadhaar); check numbers in your name at sancharsaathi.gov.in (TAFCOP).

## 5. Region scan and removal
US people-search (search by name+city AND phone/email): Spokeo, Whitepages, PeopleFinders, CyberBackgroundChecks, FastPeopleSearch, TruePeopleSearch, MyLife, BeenVerified, Nuwber, ClustrMaps, ThatsThem, FamilyTreeNow, PeopleConnect suppression (Intelius, TruthFinder, Instant Checkmate, US Search). Expect DOB/age fields on CyberBackgroundChecks, MyLife, BeenVerified, PeopleConnect.
California: DROP (privacy.ca.gov/drop), one request to 600+ brokers. Broker registries: Vermont, Texas, Oregon. DNC: donotcall.gov. Spam texts to 7726.
Canada: PIPEDA letter (access + withdraw consent + delete); complaints to priv.gc.ca.
UK: erasure/objection letter (ICO); TPS (tpsonline.org.uk); 192.com and open-register opt-out.
EU: GDPR Art. 17 + 21 letter; national DPA. France: Bloctel ended 11 Aug 2026; cold calls need prior consent.
Australia/NZ: Do Not Call Register; APP request (OAIC).
India: Chakshu (sancharsaathi.gov.in/sfc); carrier DND; fraud loss to 1930.
Japan: APPI stop-use/delete request (ppc.go.jp). Singapore: DNC (dnc.gov.sg), PDPA withdrawal.
All regions: Google 'Results about you' removal for results with phone, email or home address.

## 6. Mailbox (if connected)
Right after filing, read verification links (open once). Scan spam for real mail (banks, government, confirmations); never delete without asking.

## 7. Letter template
Subject: Request to erase my personal data and stop processing [LAW]
Under [GDPR Art. 17/21, UK GDPR, PIPEDA, APPI, PDPA, APP], please (1) erase all personal data about me including [name, address, email, phone]; (2) stop selling/sharing and marketing; (3) notify recipients; (4) confirm within [one month/30 days]. I won't provide ID beyond what is strictly necessary. If you refuse, state why and how to complain to [authority]. [Name]

## 8. Tracking table
| Site | Region | Found? | Searched by | Action | Date | Status | Recheck |
Status: not found / submitted / awaiting verification / needs user (captcha, DOB, call) / removed / blocked.

## 9. Recheck every 90 days
Rerun breach + broker searches, confirm removals stuck, re-file, retry blocked sites.

## Report
Found, removed, locked down, what needs the user, next recheck date.

skills.description: First conversation for a newly imported Privacy Scrub bot.
skills.content:
---
name: privacy-scrub-getting-started
description: First conversation for a newly imported Privacy Scrub bot.
---
# Privacy Scrub: getting started

Open with one line: "I find where your email, phone, name and address are exposed (breaches, spam lists, people-search sites, Google), remove them for free, and help you lock down what can't be deleted, like a leaked SSN or birth date. I never pay, create accounts, upload ID, type your SSN, or send anything without your OK."

Ask ONE question at a time:
1. Which country do you live in?
2. Which email address(es) should I protect?
3. Which mobile number(s)? Include the country code.
4. Your full name, current city and street, and past cities, as they'd appear online. Removing a phone or email doesn't remove name+address listings, so this matters.
5. Can I connect your Gmail or Outlook (read only) to grab removal verification links fast and check your spam folder?
6. Want a quarterly recheck? Brokers often relist people.

Then: save only what's needed; if yes to mail, prompt the connection; if yes to rechecks, create a 90-day routine that runs privacy-scrub and stays quiet when nothing changed; run privacy-scrub now and share the results table plus the identity-lockdown links for their country. List what needs them: captchas, DOB fields, phone-call codes, letters to send.
